# Miel Health - HANGZHOU AADON TRADING CO., LTD.

> Wholesale supplier of premium bee products from China since 2004. We export raw honey, fresh royal jelly, lyophilized royal jelly powder, propolis (refined extract, raw blocks, and powder), bee pollen, beeswax, and beeswax candles to global buyers. HACCP, ISO, KOSHER, and HALAL certified.

## Main Pages
- [About Us](https://www.mielhealth.com/about.html): Company background, certifications, and quality control processes for a Chinese bee products supplier established in 2004.
- [Bee Products Overview](https://www.mielhealth.com/bee-products.html): Complete catalog of wholesale bee products including honey, royal jelly, propolis, bee pollen, and beeswax.
- [Contact Us](https://www.mielhealth.com/contact.html): Request a quote for bulk bee products. Email, phone, and office address in Hangzhou, China.
- [FAQ](https://www.mielhealth.com/faq.html): Frequently asked questions about MOQ, certifications, shipping, payment terms, and product quality.

## Product Pages
- [Bulk Honey](https://www.mielhealth.com/honey.html): Wholesale raw honey from China — multifloral, acacia, and linden honey in drums or retail bottles. MOQ, specifications, and grade table.
- [Royal Jelly](https://www.mielhealth.com/royal-jelly.html): Fresh royal jelly and lyophilized royal jelly powder. 10-HDA content specifications, freeze-drying process, and bulk packaging options.
- [Propolis](https://www.mielhealth.com/propolis.html): Refined propolis extract (99%+), raw propolis blocks (55-60% purity), and water-soluble propolis powder. Flavonoid content standardized.
- [Bee Pollen](https://www.mielhealth.com/bee-pollen.html): Wholesale bee pollen granules from China. Multifloral and single-source varieties. Moisture and protein specifications.
- [Beeswax](https://www.mielhealth.com/beeswax.html): Bulk beeswax blocks and pellets. Yellow and white beeswax for cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and candle making.
- [Beeswax Candles](https://www.mielhealth.com/beeswax-candles.html): Wholesale beeswax candles — Chanukah, handroll, T-light, glass, and braid candles. Dripless and smokeless.
